title: Senior Pre-Sales Engineer Role (BMS & Fire Systems)
description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!
   

  

 Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud\-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low\- and medium\-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.
   

  

 Job Description: Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer Role (BMS \& Fire Systems)
   

  

 We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 15 years of experience in Building Management Systems (BMS) and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS). The candidate must have an Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
   

  

 This role will be based in India, providing pre\-sales engineering support to regional teams, with close collaboration with local country experts for site\-specific, regulatory, and commercial inputs.
   

  

 The role of a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer involves the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Conducting both preliminary and detailed pre\-sales engineering to assess project suitability, understand requirements, and quantify scope for BMS and Fire Alarm tenders, including service, retrofit (A\&A), and system migration projects
* Reviewing tender documents, site information, and available as\-built drawings to identify system requirements, HVAC equipment, fire alarm systems, field devices, and interface points
* Reviewing sequence of operations and fire cause \& effect, identifying gaps in specifications related to I/O summary and system requirements
* Preparing key deliverables such as RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, loop/device schedules, and bills of material, including:
* Selection and sizing of BMS devices (sensors, valves, actuators, controllers)
* Selection and configuration of fire alarm systems (detectors, modules, panels – e.g., Sinteso EN)
* Definition of system interfaces and licenses
* Developing BMS and Fire system architecture, including integration with existing and third\-party systems
* Producing technical compliance statements aligned with project specifications
* Working closely with local country experts to:
* Validate local fire code and regulatory compliance
* Incorporate actual site conditions and operational constraints
* Define scope boundaries and interfaces with other systems
* Supporting cost development by:
* Structuring and defining scope packages for subcontractors and suppliers
* Working with local teams, who will engage subcontractors and obtain budgetary quotations for relevant portions of the works
* Consolidating technical scope and cost inputs into the overall solution
* Recognising that supplier and subcontractor coordination, including quotation requests and commercial engagement, will be led by local country teams
* Identifying and mitigating technical and operational risks (e.g., legacy systems, live environment constraints), while capturing opportunities during tendering
* Preparing accurate project cost estimates, considering site constraints, phasing, and migration strategy
* Performing thorough quality checks on all deliverables prior to submission


**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills And Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of BMS, HVAC (ACMV), Electrical systems, and Fire Alarm Systems
* Understanding of fire system design principles, including cause \& effect, zoning, and fail\-safe operation
* Ability to work in a regional support model, collaborating effectively with local teams responsible for site validation, authority compliance, and supplier coordination
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Understanding of basic instrumentation and control loops
* Ability to interpret single line diagrams, fire schematics, and floor plans (including incomplete as\-built drawings)
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, M\-Bus, KNX, and system integration interfaces
* Proficiency in MS Office, Bluebeam, and AutoCAD/Groundplan tools
* Knowledge of Revit and BIM will be an added advantage
* Additional knowledge in IT networking, cybersecurity, and industry compliance practices is advantageous
* Experience in service/retrofit environments or regional/global project support will be an added advantage.


 This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
   

  

 Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens
   

  

 We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ\+, Abilities \& Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.
   

  

 Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic\-areas/smart\-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers \#SL

**Description**

 Working closely with the SDM Product Owner, you will act as the business counterpart between Sales stakeholders and Business Intelligence teams, making sure business needs are translated into practical solutions and that those solutions are genuinely adopted across the organization. * Experience working in a global organization with colleagues across Headquarters and Regions.

* This role is business\-focused and does not require a background in software development or data science.

* Experience in shipping, logistics or a commercial function is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work flexibly across time zones with Headquarters and regional counterparts.
* Experience with Agile projects or business applications is beneficial but not required

description:
About Marklytics
 



 Marklytics builds compliance software that helps manufacturers meet a new wave of product\-transparency regulation. The flagship product is VOLT TRAIL, a Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform for EV batteries. It is built around EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 and India's BPAN framework. The wider platform also covers lifecycle assessment (LCA), product traceability and regulatory reporting for batteries, steel, aluminium and other materials.
 



  





 The role
 



 You will own new business with automotive OEMs, battery manufacturers and their supply chains. The EU battery passport deadline of February 2027 is creating urgent demand, and your job is to turn that urgency into signed contracts. You'll report into leadership and work directly with the CEO and CTO on strategy, key accounts and complex deals. The CEO will shape commercial direction with you, and the CTO will back your technical conversations. Buyers include compliance, sustainability, procurement and IT.
 



  





 What you'll do
 



 •⁠ ⁠Build and run a pipeline of enterprise accounts across Europe, Asia and India, from first outreach to signed PO.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Qualify opportunities and respond to RFQs and RFPs. You'll coordinate technical content with pre\-sales and commercial terms with leadership.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Run discovery with regulatory, ESG and supply\-chain teams, and map their obligations to our platform.

 •⁠ ⁠Grow existing clients into new product lines, sites and materials.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Keep the pipeline and forecasts accurate in Apollo/CRM, and report on them weekly to the CEO and CTO.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Represent Marklytics at industry events, OEM supplier days and partner meetings, including with AWS.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Feed market and customer insight back into product and positioning.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



 Must have
 



 •⁠ ⁠4–8 years in B2B sales, in automotive, manufacturing, industrial, SaaS or any other B2B sector.
 



 •⁠ ⁠International sales exposure: you've sold to clients outside India (Europe, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, the Middle East or the US) and managed deals across time zones and cultures.
 



 •⁠ ⁠A track record of closing large deals with long sales cycles and several decision\-makers.
 



 •⁠ ⁠The confidence to learn a regulated, technical product quickly and explain it clearly to both compliance heads and CFOs.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Excellent written and spoken English. You'll co\-own proposals and client communication.
 



 Nice to have
 



 •⁠ ⁠Experience in automotive, EV or battery supply chains, or with Tier\-1 or Tier\-2 suppliers.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Exposure to sustainability, ESG or compliance software.
 



 •⁠ ⁠Familiarity with RFQ processes at global OEMs.
 



 •⁠ ⁠An existing network in the automotive or manufacturing ecosystem.

title: Senior Sales Executive - Institutional Foodservice
description:
Restomart is opening up a second sales motion focused on institutional and foodservice buyers — corporate cafeterias, industrial canteens, hospitals, hostels, contract caterers and central kitchens. This is the first dedicated hire for this segment. You'll own a longer, more structured B2B sales cycle: finding the right institutional accounts, navigating procurement and vendor onboarding, and recurring supply relationships. A pure IC role, with real scope to shape how Restomart sells into this segment.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
 •    Identify and prospect institutional and foodservice accounts, with particular focus on contract caterers and operators managing multiple kitchens/locations
 



 •    Run meetings with procurement teams and operations leads to understand sourcing requirements
 



 •    Navigate vendor registration/empanelment and commercial discussions
 



 •    Convert pilots/initial orders into stable, recurring supply relationships
 



 •    Expand accounts from a single site to multiple locations over time
 



 •    Maintain accurate pipeline and account records (WhatsApp Business, Sheets/CRM)
 



 •    Feed procurement\-process and competitor insight back to the founding team
 



  




 Target Customer Segments
 
 Corporate cafeterias/kitchens · industrial canteens · manufacturing plant kitchens · hospitals · schools/colleges/universities · hostels · large residential communities · contract catering companies · central kitchens · large catering companies · other institutional foodservice operators
 


 Sales Activities / Day\-to\-Day
 
 •    Prospecting and outreach to institutional decision\-makers
 



 •    Field meetings to scope requirements and present Restomart's offering
 



 •    Managing a multi\-step cycle: meetings → requirement mapping → vendor onboarding → commercial terms → pilot order → expansion
 



 •    Coordinating internally to get pilot orders fulfilled reliably
 



 •    Regular account reviews to identify expansion into additional sites
 



 •    Reporting on pipeline stage, cycle time and account status
 



  




 Required Experience
 
 •    2–5 years of B2B sales experience in institutional/foodservice distribution or a closely related field, with genuine relevance weighted over years
 



 •    Some exposure to longer, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles preferred
 



  




 Preferred Industry Background
 
 Institutional food distribution · foodservice distribution · FMCG institutional sales · contract catering · industrial catering · facility management (with foodservice exposure) · food ingredients · B2B food suppliers · large\-scale food distribution
 


 Required Skills
 
 •    B2B sales skills for longer, multi\-stakeholder cycles — mapping requirements, negotiating, closing
 



 •    Comfort with vendor registration/empanelment paperwork and formal quotation/RFP processes
 



 •    Basic digital fluency — WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets/a CRM
 



 •    Working fluency in Tamil and English
 



 •    Own vehicle and willingness to travel across Chennai (and occasionally beyond) for site visits
 



  




 Behavioral Traits
 
 •    Patient and process\-oriented — comfortable with a sale that takes weeks, not days, to close
 



 •    Commercially hungry, with an eye for accounts that can scale to multiple sites
 



 •    Comfortable in a startup with no existing playbook — willing to build process, not just follow it
 



 •    Strong follow\-through across a multi\-step approval chain
 



 •    High ownership; thinks in terms of account lifetime value, not just the first order
 



  




 KPIs / Success Metrics
 
 •    New institutional accounts onboarded
 



 •    Pilot\-to\-recurring\-order conversion rate
 



 •    Number of sites/locations added per account over time
 



 •    Sales cycle length and pipeline velocity
 



 •    Revenue per account and account retention
 



  




 Compensation
 
 Based on Industry Standards and years of experience.
 


 Why Join Restomart
 
 You'll be the first salesperson building Restomart's institutional and foodservice business — not inheriting a territory, but defining how it's sold. Land a few contract caterers or multi\-site institutional accounts and you're not just hitting a number, you're building a recurring revenue base that shapes the next phase of the company, with a clear path to leading this vertical as it grows.
 


 Candidate Profile Snapshot
 * A B2B salesperson — roughly 2–5 years, weighted toward relevance over tenure — who has sold into institutional/foodservice buyers or contract caterers, is comfortable with a longer cycle and real procurement process, and gets energized by the size of what one well\-landed multi\-site account can become.

title: Sales Executive
description:
**About Eduspace** 




  





**Most people selling career services have never had to find a job the hard way. We have.** 




**Eduspace helps jobseekers in the US, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia get hired through CV writing, LinkedIn optimization, interview prep and job search strategy. We've worked with 3,000\+ jobseekers and a 20,000\+ recruiter network. Our founder spent years inside the biggest EdTech companies and wrote** 
*EdTech Exposed* 
 about the pressure\-selling he saw there. So we sell differently: honestly, or not at all.
 



  





**The role** 




  





**You'll talk to jobseekers who are frustrated, ghosted, or stuck. Your job is to understand where they are, tell them straight whether we can help, and enrol the ones we can. Some calls will end with you telling someone they don't need us yet. That's a good call here.** 




  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Run discovery calls with inbound leads from our content, website and referrals
* Diagnose each person's job search problem and match them to the right service (CV, LinkedIn, interview prep, or full job search support)
* Explain pricing and scope clearly, with no inflated promises about outcomes
* Follow up with prospects in a way you'd be comfortable receiving yourself
* Keep the CRM accurate: every lead, call note and next step
* Feed back what you hear on calls so we can improve our services and content



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 1 to 3\+ years in consultative sales, ideally in education, career services, recruitment, coaching or SaaS
* You're comfortable talking to people at every level, from fresh graduates to senior professionals
* You can listen for the real problem behind "I just need a better CV"
* Clear, warm written and spoken English
* Self\-directed. You manage your own pipeline and hours well
* Bonus: you've been an international student, changed careers, or run a tough job search yourself



  





**What we won't ask you to do** 




  





**No fake deadlines. No "only 2 spots left." No guilt trips aimed at parents or graduates. No promising a job offer. If that's how you've been trained to sell, this role will feel different. We think that's the point.** 




  





**Why join** 




  




* Warm inbound leads from an active content audience, not cold lists
* A product you can stand behind, built by people who've done the job search themselves
* Direct access to the founder and a say in how the sales process grows



**To apply** 




  




* **Send your CV and a short note to hello@jabezivanj.com answering one question: tell us about a sale you walked away from, and why.**

description:

**Company:** 
 Teceze
 



**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development

 Onsite \- Chennai / Bangalore
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Business Development Manager / Head of Sales
 



  





**Role Summary** 




  





 Teceze is looking for a
 **Business Development Executive (BDE)** 
 to drive new business growth through outbound prospecting, cold calling, and lead generation. The primary objective of this role is to identify and engage potential customers, qualify opportunities, and schedule Microsoft Teams meetings for the senior sales team.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who is energetic, target\-driven, and comfortable speaking to decision\-makers in IT, procurement, and business leadership.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Outbound Prospecting \& Lead Generation
 


* Conduct daily outbound calls to prospects across assigned regions and segments.
* Run structured outreach campaigns using cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn.
* Research target accounts, identify key stakeholders such as CIOs, IT Directors, Procurement, HR, etc., and build high\-quality prospect lists.
* Qualify leads based on agreed criteria, including budget, need, authority, timeline, and fit.



 2\. Meeting Scheduling – Microsoft Teams
 


* Schedule Microsoft Teams meetings for senior sales leaders and solution consultants with qualified prospects.
* Manage and coordinate calendars, send meeting invites, and ensure all relevant details are captured.
* Follow up with prospects to confirm attendance and reschedule meetings when required.



 3\. Pipeline Management \& CRM Hygiene
 


* Log all interactions, including calls, emails, LinkedIn outreach, and meetings, accurately and on time in the CRM.
* Maintain an up\-to\-date pipeline of leads and opportunities with clear next steps.
* Prepare basic activity reports covering calls made, meetings booked, leads generated, conversions, etc.



 4\. Collaboration with Sales \& Marketing
 


* Work closely with the Sales Team to understand target industries, service offerings, and ideal customer profiles.
* Coordinate with Marketing on campaigns, follow\-up lists, and messaging.
* Share market feedback, including objections, competitor insights, and customer requirements, to improve sales pitches and campaigns.



 5\. Sales Support \& Follow\-Up
 


* Send follow\-up emails after initial conversations and meetings, including recaps, next steps, and relevant presentations.
* Support the Sales Team with prospect information, research, and contact validation.
* Nurture early\-stage leads until they are ready to be converted into qualified opportunities.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Number of outbound calls made per day/week.
* Number of qualified Microsoft Teams meetings scheduled.
* Conversion rate from contact → meeting → qualified lead.
* Volume and quality of new leads added to the sales pipeline.
* CRM accuracy and data quality.
* Follow\-up and lead nurturing effectiveness.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


1. 2–5 years of experience in Business Development, Inside Sales, Tele\-Sales, or B2B Sales; IT services or B2B technology experience is must.
2. MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or a related field is preferred.
3. Strong verbal communication skills and confidence in making outbound calls.
4. Good written communication skills for emails and LinkedIn messaging.
5. Familiarity with Microsoft Teams and CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
6. Basic proficiency in productivity tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.
7. Ability to quickly understand and articulate Teceze’s services, including IT Support, FSO, Digital Workplace, and Infrastructure Services.
8. Strong prospecting, lead qualification, and appointment\-setting skills.
9. Target\-driven mindset with resilience and the ability to handle rejection.
10. Strong organizational, time\-management, communication, and relationship\-building skills.



 Diversity \& Inclusion
 


* Teceze is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
 
 Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply, particularly those with an MBA/PGDM background in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, or a related field, who are passionate about building a career in Business Development and Sales.

 ZiAn Ventures partners with technically strong founders who have built real products but need clarity and structure around growth, go\-to\-market, and revenue. The firm focuses on solving issues such as unclear GTM, misaligned messaging, weak distribution, and over\-reliance on the founder for growth. title: Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder
description:
Digital Coaching Business Strategist / Digital Coaching Community Builder — ExpertsBIO 🎯
   


 Remote \| ₹24–60 lakh/year realistic earning \| Base \+ uncapped commission
 



  





**About ExpertsBIO** 





 India's performance marketing partner built exclusively for coaches. For 8 years we've worked with 100\+ coaches, managed crores in ad spend, and built revenue engines for some of the most recognised names in Indian coaching.
 





 Here's why this role exists. Too many coaches are getting scammed and left without the help they actually need. We're building a genuinely value\-driven community to change that. We want someone capable enough to run this on their own — and that's the point: you get to be an intrapreneur, building your own thing, but coached by people who've already done it for hundreds of coaches over 8 years, with the contacts and the playbook to match. We run on performance, not salaries and comfort. If that's your language, keep reading.
 




  





**The Role — in plain terms** 





 You'll run a free online community where coaches come to learn and grow. Your job is to genuinely help them — fix their offer, sort out their business model, guide their funnel — so they get real results and come to trust you. Because they trust you, you'll then guide the right coaches into our paid programs and tools, and earn commission on every sale. As the community grows, you find new things to offer them and make more. You build the audience, you help them, you sell to them — all of it is yours.
 




  





**What You'll Actually Do Day to Day** 



* Grow and run the community — bring coaches in, keep them engaged, make it a place they show up for.
* Run live webinar sessions and workshops that teach, build trust, and sell to the room.
* Sit with coaches' problems and give real solutions: their offer, pricing, model, funnel.
* Spot what each coach needs next and point them to the right paid program or tool.
* Sell them into our coaching programs, software tools, and agency services — and earn on it.
* As the audience grows, find and launch new things to sell to them.
* Track your own numbers and own the results.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Proof you've already helped coaches scale — real numbers, not claims.
* Deep grasp of coaching business models and the funnels that work in this industry.
* Full\-stack literacy: enough command of copywriting, media buying, design, video editing and scripting, UI/UX, and AI to 
 *teach* 
  coaches and get them results.
* Can hold a live room — webinar, challenge, workshop — and move the whole audience to a decision.
* Entrepreneurial fire and the confidence to back yourself.



  





**What We're Not Looking For** 



* If you need a fixed salary to feel secure, this is not for you.
* If you've never worked with coaches or info\-products, this isn't the right fit.
* If you want to clock in and be chased for output, please don't apply.



  





**Compensation — annual package** 



* Base: ₹4\.2–12 lakh/year (₹35,000–₹1,00,000/month), based on track record.
* Commission: uncapped. You're expected to clear at least ₹18 lakh/year (₹1\.5 lakh/month) in commission to hold this seat.
* Realistic total for the right person: ₹24–60 lakh/year (₹2–5 lakh/month) — and no ceiling as you open new avenues.



  





**Who Thrives Here** 





 The person who 
 
*wants* 
  ₹24–60 lakh a year and has the fire to pull it off. Who's excited that their income is tied to what they build, not what they're handed. If that's you, we'll give you the audience, the offers, and the room to make serious money.
 



  





**To Apply** 





 Click Apply and complete the Google Form. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.

title: Senior Integration Developer - Dynamics 365 Sales
description:
**Primary Job Purpose**
 Act as the Senior Integration Developer for Dynamics 365 Sales, with responsibility for integrations with other systems and processes. Engage with the business to understand requirements, develop and maintain customizations, produce software development lifecycle artifacts, perform PoCs, and communicate deliverables to business and technology teams. The role includes a range of tasks focused on maintaining, supporting, and enhancing the Dynamics 365 CRM system, including its integrations with ERP, CPQ, and other downstream systems.
   

  

**Key Position Accountabilities**
* Design and implement plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom integrations.

* Ensure smooth operation of CRM system by monitoring, maintaining and managing configurations, security settings and integrations.
* Investigate and resolve technical problems, errors or bugs in the CRM system, collaborating with business, IT, or development teams as necessary.
* Support integrations between Dynamics 365 and ERP/external systems via middleware platforms, including troubleshooting data sync issues across account, quote, and order records.

* Generate user and technical documentation.
* Attain high stakeholder satisfaction, ensuring on\-time, on\-budget delivery with quality results.

* B.E. Degree in IT (or equivalent).
* 6\+ years' experience in a similar role.
* MS Dynamics 365 CE \& Sales Certified, Specialist in the Sales Module.
* MS Dynamics Customization \& Configuration certification, or Microsoft Power Platform \+ Dynamics 365 Core certification, with applied experience.
* Tacton CPQ or any other CPQ experience is preferred
* Customized Microsoft Dynamics CRM at the form, entity, relationship, reports, workflow, dialogs, and business unit/user role permission level.
* Strong experience building integrations between Dynamics CRM and ERP \& other external systems, including middleware\-based integration patterns and secure API/OAuth\-based authentication.
* Strong experience customizing \& configuring Dynamics 365 CE solutions.
* Experience supporting data migration or system cutover activities, including data validation and reconciliation.
* Knowledge of CRM implementation best practices.
* Experience in agile development practices \& methodologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills to engage with all levels in the organization.
* Highly detail\-oriented with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Self\-motivated with ability to establish priorities and work independently.

title: Sales Planning - Project Delivery SME
description:
**Overview**
 To act as the senior domain authority for Sales Planning across the engagement — owning the “how it should work” for quota setting, territory/module design and hierarchy management, guiding the analyst squads, and safeguarding accuracy, timeliness and governance across the annual planning cycle and in\-year changes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Quota management — own the end\-to\-end quota\-setting and allocation process: translate finance/budget targets to account and seller level, run zero\-sum and over\-assignment logic, and issue target letters accurately and on time.
* Territory \& module design — design, assign and rebalance territories/modules using opportunity, capacity and coverage inputs; protect seller continuity while improving balance and fairness.
* Hierarchy management — maintain the sales hierarchy (account\-to\-seller alignment, overlays, parent rollups) through joiners, leavers and reorganisations, keeping downstream systems consistent.
* Capacity \& coverage modelling — analyse coverage, white space and account load vs capacity to inform planning decisions with data rather than intuition.
* In\-year adjustments — govern mid\-year quota modulations, relief requests and re\-alignments through a disciplined, auditable change process.
* Planning cycle governance — run the planning calendar to plan; drive on\-time quota finalisation and reduce post\-lock change volume.
* Issue \& ticket resolution — resolve escalated planning queries (missing sales, alignment, hierarchy) and drive down recurring demand through root\-cause and prevention.
* Reporting \& insight — produce attainment, coverage and forecast\-to\-actual reporting; ensure reporting accuracy, not just timeliness.
* SME guidance \& knowledge — coach and unblock the analyst squads, author and maintain SOPs/runbooks and the exception library, and lead knowledge transfer during transition.


**Requirements**
* 8\-12 years in Sales Planning, Sales Operations or Sales Performance Management (SPM), with deep hands\-on quota and territory expertise.
* Strong command of quota\-setting methodologies, territory/module design, hierarchy management and capacity/coverage modelling.
* Hands\-on familiarity with SPM / planning tooling (e.g., Varicent, Anaplan, Xactly, SAP, or equivalent) and territory\-optimisation tools.
* Advanced data skills — Excel to an expert level; comfort with large datasets, reconciliation and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Proven ability to standardise fragmented, manual processes into governed, repeatable operating procedures.
* Strong stakeholder management — able to work with Finance, Sales leadership and cross\-functional partners, and to represent the function credibly to the client.
* Excellent analytical, documentation and communication skills; comfortable being the escalation point for complex planning questions.

title: Sales Enablement Senior Analyst
description:
**Content Manager – Sales Enablement**
 The Content Manager is responsible for creating and maintaining sales\-ready materials within the Global Knowledgebase and associated sales repositories. This position operates under and reports to the sales enablement. This role requires a strong commitment to producing well\-organized, customer\-focused content that clearly conveys key messages and effectively showcases the benefits of products or services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee the narrative strategy to ensure content effectively engages and resonates with its intended audience.
* Improve repository development through the integration of pertinent artifacts into the content management system.
* Source and consolidate reusable, proposal\-specific materials from diverse organizational channels.
* Develop a comprehensive content strategy that aligns with both immediate and long\-term marketing objectives.
* Collaborate with marketing and design teams to strategically plan and optimize content, visual aesthetics, and presentation layouts.
* Edit, proofread, and elevate content artifacts to ensure consistency and maintain high quality standards.
* Upload NTT DATA’s sales materials to content platforms after obtaining necessary expert approvals.
* Evaluate and organize materials to prepare client\-ready documents and identify needed updates.
* Delegate tasks to translators, editors, and designers as required for content refinement.
* Methodically categorize collateral within the knowledgebase and update it with pertinent, company\-specific resources.
* Ensure accurate assignment of metadata, monitor for duplication, and confirm format compliance with established templates.
* Verify all artifacts are clearly labeled and accompanied by appropriate informational tags in accordance with sales enablement guidelines.


**Content Lifecycle Management**
* Demonstrates comprehensive expertise in all facets of content creation and distribution.
* Manages content expiration schedules and coordinates archival procedures as required.
* Performs regular assessments of the repository to maintain accurate taxonomy tagging practices.
* Oversee and tracks expiration timelines, collaborating proactively with subject matter experts to ensure timely updates ahead of deadlines.
* Compile periodic reports summarizing content inventory and publication metrics.
* Conducts webinars and workshops to educate new users on best practices for effective repository utilization.


**Collaboration And Additional Duties**
* Develop and sustain a robust network of subject matter experts throughout the organization to facilitate effective content creation and maintenance.
* Address inquiries and engage with subject matter experts to provide continuous support.
* Partner with the sales enablement team to produce promotional materials as required.
* Work in close coordination with IT to assist in implementing system enhancements.


**Preferred Candidate Profile**
* A bachelor’s degree in communications, English, or a related discipline is required; an MBA is preferred.
* Over seven years of relevant experience in content management or a similar capacity.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced computer literacy with familiarity in leading content management systems; knowledge of SharePoint is preferred but not required.
* Proficiency in MS Word, PPT, and Excel.
* Proven ability to develop engaging content that encourages audience interaction.
* Strong leadership abilities.

title: Business Development Consultant / Manager
description:
**Startup \& Venture Ecosystem** 




  





**Business Development Consultant / Manager** 




  





**Chennai / Remote • Full\-time** 




  





**Multiple openings • 3–15 years of experience • B2B Sales** 




  





**Who We Are** 




  






 YNOS Venture Engine is India's data intelligence platform for the early\-stage startup ecosystem. Founded by IIT Madras faculty and incubated at IIT Madras, we sit at the intersection of data, technology, and India's startup economy.
 




  






 Our long\-term vision is to become India's supermarket for startups — the central platform through which any actor in the ecosystem such as Investors, Incubators, research institutions, service providers and Banks can discover, engage with, and transact with the startup world.
 




  






 For our startup customers, we are building out the other side of that marketplace: access to capital, talent, business advisory, accounting, compliance and financing advisory.
 




  






 We are currently building the commercial engine that takes us there.
 




  





**What We Are Hiring For** 




  






 We are expanding our Business team and hiring for multiple roles, each responsible for distinct segments of the startup ecosystem in India.
 




  






 We have openings for Business development Consultant / Manager across the following segments:
 




  




* **VCs** 

 — venture capital funds, family offices and angel networks.
* **Government** 

 — state startup missions, central and state departments, and policy and ecosystem development bodies.
* **Corporates \& Banks** 

 — corporate venture arms, open innovation and startup scouting teams, and banks building startup and SME propositions.
* **Incubators \& Accelerators** 

 — incubators, accelerators, TBIs and startup support organisations.



  





**The Opportunity** 




  






 As a Business Development Consultant / Manager, you will:
 




  




* Be responsible for achieving monthly, quarterly and yearly revenue targets for your segment.
* Own a defined territory and segment of the market, and run the full B2B sales cycle: discovery, solution mapping, proposal design, negotiation, and close.
* Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects annually, prioritise high\-intent accounts using a structured scoring framework.
* Own the entire journey — from first interaction through conversion, renewal, and referral — including inbound and outbound leads generated through the community, webinars, and platform activity.
* Have a "customer first" approach and ensure internal collaboration so that clients stay satisfied.
* Represent YNOS in the field. Attend and support institutional programmes and external events that deepen relationships and create upsell opportunities, and relay market feedback to the BD Head and leadership in real time.
* Support marketing team to drive success of pitch fests and events.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* **3–15 years of B2B sales experience** 

 for Consultant (3\-10 yrs) and Manager (8\-15 yrs) roles, with a track record of independently owning and closing deals.
* Prior experience selling software, digital platforms, consulting or data services is strongly preferred.
* Experience selling to or working within the startup, VC and investor ecosystem in India — educational institutions, incubators, funds, corporates, government bodies or founders — is a significant advantage.
* You have developed a sales philosophy — you know how you build relationships, how you read a room, and how you close without burning trust.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Disciplined with process: CRM hygiene, pipeline management, and follow\-up.
* Well organised, detail\-oriented and reliable, with excellent time management and an ability to meet deadlines and targets.
* A graduate degree is mandatory. An MBA is a plus, not a requirement.



  






 This is a role for someone who understands the founder and institutional mindset, builds trust quickly, and finds genuine satisfaction in helping the ecosystem take a step forward.
 




  





**Work Location \& Job Type** 




  




* Our Chennai office is located at
 
**IIT Madras Research Park, Chennai** 

 , surrounded by the beautiful IITM campus.
* Candidates based out of
 
**Hyderabad / Bengaluru / Mumbai** 

 may also apply.

title: Lead - Channel Sales
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

 We are looking for a
 **Channel Manager – Middle East \& Africa (MEA)** 
 to build, activate and grow Freshworks’ partner ecosystem across the region.
   

  





 This role is responsible for creating
 **incremental business through the partner ecosystem** 
 — identifying the right partners, enabling them to sell and deliver Freshworks solutions, building joint go\-to\-market motions, generating qualified pipeline and ensuring strong execution across the partner lifecycle.
   

  





 The role requires a strong balance of
 **commercial ownership, partner management, sales alignment and operational discipline** 
 .
   

  





 The Channel Manager will work closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances and other cross\-functional teams to make partners a meaningful growth channel for Freshworks.
   

  





**. Partner Strategy \& Business Development**



* Develop and execute the partner strategy for assigned markets and segments across MEA.
* Identify and recruit partners that can provide meaningful customer access, technical capability, industry expertise or geographic coverage.
* Evaluate partners based on their ability to generate pipeline, influence customers, implement solutions and build a sustainable Freshworks practice.
* Develop joint business plans with priority partners, including revenue objectives, target accounts, GTM activities and capability\-building priorities.
* Build relationships with senior stakeholders within the partner organization and establish clear mutual accountability.



**2\. Partner Activation \& Readiness**



* Own the activation of newly recruited partners and move them from onboarding to productive engagement.
* Drive partner readiness across product knowledge, sales capability, solution positioning, certifications and implementation capability.
* Identify capability gaps and create focused enablement plans rather than relying on generic training.
* Establish measurable activation milestones and monitor progress against them.
* Ensure partners have the tools, knowledge and internal champions required to independently position and sell Freshworks.



**3\. Pipeline Generation \& Revenue Growth**



* Own partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline generation for the assigned territory.
* Build joint campaigns, account\-mapping exercises, workshops, roundtables and other pipeline\-generation initiatives with priority partners.
* Identify opportunities where partner access or capability can create incremental Freshworks revenue.
* Work with Sales teams to convert partner\-generated pipeline into qualified opportunities and closed business.
* Track partner contribution across the funnel — from recruitment and activation through pipeline, conversion and revenue.
* Identify gaps early and build corrective action plans with partners and internal stakeholders.



**4\. Joint GTM \& Field Alignment**



* Build strong relationships with Freshworks Account Executives and Sales leadership to align partner activity with territory priorities.
* Facilitate joint account planning between Freshworks and partners.
* Bring partners into relevant enterprise opportunities where they add customer access, technical expertise, implementation capability or commercial leverage.
* Ensure the right level of partner involvement based on the opportunity rather than involving partners purely for attribution.
* Support strategic partner\-led and partner\-assisted opportunities through the sales cycle.



**5\. Partner Governance \& Performance Management**



* Establish regular operating cadences with priority partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews and action tracking.
* Maintain visibility into partner performance, pipeline quality, conversion, activity and readiness.
* Hold partners accountable to agreed commitments and follow through on action items.
* Identify underperforming or inactive partners and develop clear activation, remediation or rationalization plans.
* Maintain accurate partner and opportunity information across Freshworks systems and reporting mechanisms.



**6\. Opportunity \& Deal Support**



* Support partner registration, opportunity alignment, attribution and commercial processes in accordance with Freshworks policies.
* Ensure partner involvement and contribution are clearly documented.
* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations and other teams where partner\-related issues affect deal execution.
* Escalate partner\-related blockers appropriately and drive them to resolution.
* Protect a consistent customer experience while ensuring the partner receives the appropriate support.



**7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration**




 Work closely with:
   

  




* **Sales / Account Executives:** 
 account planning, opportunity creation and conversion
* **Solution Consulting:** 
 technical readiness, demos and solution positioning
* **Customer Success:** 
 expansion, adoption and partner\-supported customer outcomes
* **Marketing:** 
 campaigns, events, demand generation and partner marketing
* **Partner Enablement:** 
 certifications and capability development
* **Operations / Finance:** 
 commercial processes, attribution and operational execution
* **Leadership:** 
 partner strategy, performance reviews and regional priorities



**Role Boundaries**




 The Channel Manager is accountable for
 **partner growth, activation, engagement and partner\-led pipeline to ensure larger market share.**




**Success Measures**




 Success in this role will be measured through a combination of
 **partner productivity, pipeline creation, revenue contribution and ecosystem health** 
 , including:
   

  




* Partner addition and activation
* Partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline
* Partner\-attributed revenue / ARR
* Partner pipeline conversion
* Revenue/Quality of activated partners
* Partner readiness and certification
* Joint account\-planning coverage
* Partner\-led GTM activity and resulting pipeline
* Strategic partner engagement and business\-plan execution
* Partner productivity and contribution to regional growth
* Accuracy of partner attribution and opportunity governance



 The focus is on
 **productive partners and measurable business outcomes** 
 , not simply the number of partners recruited.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience in channel sales, alliances, partner management, indirect sales or B2B technology sales.
* Experience working with partners such as SIs, MSPs, VARs, distributors, cloud partners or technology specialists.
* Experience managing enterprise technology sales cycles and partner\-led opportunities.
* Experience working across multiple countries or markets is strongly preferred.
* Experience in SaaS, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, cybersecurity, cloud or adjacent enterprise technology categories is an advantage.



**Skills**



* Strong commercial and business\-development mindset.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with both partners and internal sales teams.
* Strong understanding of indirect sales and partner economics.
* Ability to identify where a partner can create genuine incremental value.
* Strong pipeline\-management and forecasting discipline.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving, matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to manage partner performance.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

description:

 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Deep expertise in B2B Sales transformation and end\-to\-end Sales process strategy, including Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Sales Planning, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
* Proven ability to define and govern process transformation methodologies, process redesign standards, quality frameworks, and transformation governance across multiple client engagements.

 Good\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling applications to develop enterprise process architectures and detailed Sales process designs.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation and emerging AI\-enabled Sales platforms and applications.


**Experience**
* 12 \-20 years of experience in management consulting, process transformation, Sales transformation, Enterprise Sales Strategy, Sales Operations, or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi\-workstream transformation programs and advising senior client stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams across multiple engagements.
* Proven experience in Business Development, RFP/RFI responses, proposal leadership, and pursuit management.
* Demonstrated experience working across business and technology stakeholders to deliver enterprise transformation.


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.
* MBA/PGDM (Preferred)


**Job Summary**
 As a Senior Manager– B2B Sales Transformation, Enterprise Sales Strategy \& Industry Advisory, you will define and lead how Sales transformation is delivered across clients, while establishing the methodologies, governance standards, assets, and industry perspectives that enable consistent, high\-quality outcomes. You will bring deep expertise across the B2B Sales value chain, connecting Enterprise Sales Strategy and Go\-to\-Market priorities with end\-to\-end Sales process steps, operating models, technology platforms, data, AI, and organizational capabilities. You will advise senior client stakeholders on how to transform their sales organizations across areas such as Sales Strategy, GTM, Sales Operating Model, Sales Force Effectiveness, Sales Productivity, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Revenue Operations.
   

  

 As a Senior Manager will serve as an Industry Advisor for clients across Software \& Platforms, High Tech, and Communications \& Media, bringing an informed perspective on market trends, competitive dynamics, industry\-specific Sales models, emerging technologies, and opportunities for AI\-led transformation. You will establish and govern the process transformation methodology used by your teams, ensuring that future\-state Sales processes, operating models, technology requirements, and AI integration are designed consistently and to a high standard. You will also lead Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, shaping opportunities, developing differentiated solutions, leading proposal responses, and partnering with senior Accenture leadership to grow the Sales Transformation portfolio.
   

  

 As AI becomes embedded across Sales processes, you will establish AX Design as a core component of the transformation methodology—defining how humans, AI agents, and business processes work together and establishing standards for agent autonomy, decision boundaries, escalation, governance, and human\-agent handoffs.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

 Enterprise Sales Strategy \& Transformation
   

  

* Lead development of Enterprise Sales Strategy and Sales Transformation agendas for clients across Software \& Platforms, High Tech, and Communications \& Media.
* Define and shape transformation strategies across GTM, Sales Operating Model, Sales Force Effectiveness, Sales Productivity, Sales Planning, Forecasting, and Revenue Operations.

* Develop strategic points of view, transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating models, and executive recommendations.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior Sales, Commercial, Operations, Technology, and Transformation executives.

* Define and govern transformation approaches across the end\-to\-end B2B Sales lifecycle.
* Establish standards for assessing, redesigning, and optimizing Sales processes including:
* Lead Management \& Qualification
* Lead\-to\-Opportunity
* Opportunity Management
* Pipeline Management
* Account Management
* Sales Planning \& Forecasting
* CPQ \& Deal Management
* Contract Management
* Order Management
* Sales Operations \& Revenue Operations
* Define how Sales process redesign should connect business strategy, people, process, technology, data, governance, and operating model.
* Review and approve significant future\-state process designs before client delivery.
* Establish quality standards and governance mechanisms across the process transformation portfolio.


 Sales Platforms \& Applications
   

  

* Provide strategic guidance on how Sales platforms and enterprise applications should enable future\-state Sales processes.
* Advise on platforms including CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management.
* Partners with technology and architecture teams to ensure business process and platform design are aligned.
* Define process\-to\-platform alignment, integration requirements, data flows, automation opportunities, and user experience considerations.
* Use Microsoft Visio and other process modeling tools to establish enterprise process architectures and detailed Sales process models.
* Ensure technology\-delivery teams understand and appropriately implement the intended business process transformation.


 Process Transformation Methodology \& Governance

* Current\-state assessment
* Industry and market analysis
* Process maturity assessment
* Benchmarking
* Future\-state design
* Operating model alignment

* Change and adoption
* Transformation roadmap

* Establish review and approval mechanisms for major process transformation deliverables.
* Develop and maintain Sales transformation methodologies, playbooks, accelerators, frameworks, and intellectual property.

**Job Description**

 Freshservice is expanding what “AI\-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.
   

  





 This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands\-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post\-sale. You'll be the AI subject\-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.
   

  





 You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.
   

  





**What You'll Do**



* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs\-of\-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent\-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal\-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof\-of\-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de\-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business\-case models that the wider SE team can self\-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one\-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go\-to expert.


**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**



* 8\+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands\-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM\-based solutions in a customer\-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG\-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production\-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one\-size\-fits\-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof\-of\-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX\-leader audience or down to a hands\-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.



**Nice to Have**



* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42\) and how it feeds AI\-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.

**Job Description Template**
 Job Title \- Consultant – Process Excellence
   

  

 Management Level: 09 \- Consultant
   

  

 Location: Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad
   

  

 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Strong understanding of B2B Sales processes and end\-to\-end Sales process steps, including Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
* Experience in process excellence, process redesign, process optimization, benchmarking, and data analysis.
* Ability to analyze current\-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support the design of future\-state Sales processes and operating models.
* Working knowledge of AI, GenAI, automation, and AI\-assisted analytics and their application to business and Sales process transformation.
* Ability to conduct research, analyze industry trends, and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently and progressively take ownership of assigned deliverables.


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with process mapping, process modeling, and visualization tools, including Microsoft Visio or equivalent applications.
* Exposure to Sales platforms and applications, CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), CPQ (Salesforce, Conga, SAP), CLM (Icertis Conga), Sales Planning (Anaplan, Xactly), Forecasting (Clari, Aviso), Incentive Compensation (Varicent, SAP Callidus), Order Management (Salesforce, SAP), and Revenue Management (Salesforce, SAP) platforms.
* Familiarity with AX Design and the application of AI\-agent concepts within business processes.
* Experience supporting Business Development (BD), proposal development, RFP/RFI responses, solutioning, and client presentations.
* Client\-facing consulting, workshop facilitation, and stakeholder management experience.
* Exposure to change\-impact assessment across people, process, technology, data, and operating model dimensions.
* Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, GenAI platforms, or other analytics and visualization tools.


**Experience**
* 4\-9 years of experience in management consulting, process excellence, process redesign, Sales Operations, business transformation, or related areas, with increasing levels of independence.
* Experience or exposure to B2B Sales transformation and Sales process improvement is preferred.
* Experience supporting BD pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, or solutioning activities is an advantage.


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.
* MBA/PGDM (Preferred)


**Job Summary**
 As a consultant – B2B Sales Transformation \& Process Excellence, you will support clients in analyzing, redesigning, and transforming their end\-to\-end B2B Sales processes. You will work across key Sales process steps, from Lead Management and Qualification through Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations, helping identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, platform enablement, and AI\-led transformation. You will conduct industry research, benchmarking, data analysis, and process assessments to develop insights that support transformation recommendations.
   

  

 You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including research, solution development, process narratives, capability presentations, proposal content, and client\-ready materials. The role will involve working with Sales platforms and enterprise applications, understanding how technology enables business processes, and supporting digital and platform transformation initiatives. You will use tools such as Microsoft Visio, Power BI, Tableau, and GenAI\-enabled platforms to analyze, visualize, and communicate findings. You will also develop an understanding of AX Design, recognizing how AI agents can be embedded within redesigned Sales processes. This includes defining where AI can operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, and how AI\-to\-human handoffs should be designed. You will primarily support engagements across the Software \& Platforms, High Tech, and Communications \& Media industries, while developing broader cross\-industry Sales transformation expertise.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

 B2B Sales Process \& Transformation
   

  

* Analyze current\-state B2B Sales processes and document process steps, activities, roles, systems, data, controls, and pain points.
* Support the design of future\-state Sales processes, identifying opportunities for simplification, standardization, digitization, automation, and AI enablement.
* Develop process assessments across the Sales lifecycle, including:
* Lead\-to\-Opportunity
* Lead Qualification
* Opportunity Management
* Pipeline Management
* Sales Forecasting
* Account Management
* CPQ and Deal Management
* Contract Management
* Order Management
* Sales Operations and Revenue Operations
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support the development of Sales operating models, process standards, functional requirements, playbooks, and transformation of roadmaps.


 Process Excellence \& Analytics
   

  

* Conduct process excellence, benchmarking, and maturity assessments to identify improvement opportunities.
* Develop industry and functional trend assessments across Software \& Platforms, High Tech, and Communications \& Media.
* Build analytical frameworks and data\-driven assessments using AI\-assisted analytics and visualization tools.
* Analyze business and operational data and translate findings into structured insights and recommendations.
* Conduct peer and industry benchmarking to assess client performance against relevant market practices.
* Develop supporting materials, dashboards, presentations, and executive\-ready recommendations.


 Sales Platforms \& Applications
   

  

* Support assessments of Sales platforms and applications and their alignment with business processes and user requirements.
* Analyze how CRM, Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Forecasting, Sales Planning, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and other Sales applications enable the Sales lifecycle.
* Develop process maps and workflows using Microsoft Visio and other process modeling/visualization tools.
* Support requirements gathering, functional analysis, process design, and platform transformation activities.
* Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, AI, and GenAI across Sales process steps.


 AI, GenAI \& AX Design
   

  

* Apply relevant AI and GenAI tools across research, analysis, process assessment, documentation, and deliverable creation.
* Explore opportunities to embed AI and automation within Sales processes to improve productivity, decision\-making, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
* Apply AX Design principles when assessing AI\-enabled processes.
* Define how AI agents could operate within individual Sales process steps, including:
* Activities handled autonomously by AI
* Decision\-making boundaries
* Human intervention requirements
* AI\-to\-human handoffs
* Controls and governance
* Support the development of AI\-enabled process concepts, use cases, and transformation recommendations.


 Business Development \& RFP Support
   

  

* Support Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
* Conduct client, industry, competitor, and market research to support pursuit strategies.
* Develop RFP responses, solution narratives, process diagrams, capability presentations, case studies, and proposal content.
* Translate client requirements into structured Sales transformation approaches and solution concepts.
* Support development of value propositions, solution approaches, delivery models, and transformation roadmaps.
* Contribute to client presentations, workshops, demonstrations, and pursuit discussions.
* Collaborate with senior consultants and leadership teams to develop differentiated and client\-relevant solutions.


 Client \& Engagement Support
   

  

* Participate in client workshops and stakeholder discussions to understand business requirements, pain points, and transformation objectives.
* Support interviews and working sessions with Sales, Operations, Technology, and Business stakeholders.
* Develop clear and structured communication materials for clients and leadership review.
* Conduct change\-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating model changes.
* Incorporate stakeholder feedback into process and transformation designs.


 Professional \& Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong understanding of B2B Sales processes and Sales process steps.
* Knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation concepts.
* Experience or exposure to process excellence, process redesign, benchmarking, and process optimization.
* Ability to perform data analysis and AI\-assisted analytics.
* Working knowledge of how AI, GenAI, automation, and digital technologies can be incorporated into business processes.
* Experience with or exposure to Sales platforms and applications such as CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, and Order Management.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, GenAI platforms, or similar analytical and visualization tools.
* Ability to convert analytical findings into structured business recommendations and executive\-ready deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.


 Business Development \& Consulting Skills
   

  

* Exposure to RFP/RFI response management and proposal development.
* Ability to develop client\-ready presentations, solution narratives, process diagrams, and supporting materials.
* Strong research and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to communicate complex business and technology concepts in clear business language.
* Exposure to client\-facing consulting, stakeholder management, and workshop facilitation.
* Ability to work effectively with distributed, cross\-functional, and multicultural teams.
* Demonstrated ability to take increasing ownership of workstreams and deliverables.


 Industry Focus
   

  

 The role will support consulting and transformation engagements primarily across:
   

  

* Software \& Platforms
* High Tech
* Communications \& Media


 Candidates should demonstrate an interest in understanding industry\-specific Sales models, go\-to\-market strategies, operating models, Sales processes, and technology landscapes.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

* Strong interest in B2B Sales transformation, process excellence, digital transformation, AI, and emerging Sales technologies.
* Familiarity with process mapping and modeling using Visio or similar tools.
* Growing understanding of AX Design, AI\-agent behavior, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, and human\-machine collaboration.
* Ability to work across both client delivery and Business Development/RFP activities.
* Willingness to continuously build expertise across Sales processes, Sales platforms, industry trends, AI/GenAI, and consulting methodologies.

title: Pre-sales Head
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
 To lead the Pre\-Sales function with end\-to\-end ownership of the lead\-to\-site\-visit funnel, ensuring effective lead management, customer engagement, conversion, team productivity and CRM discipline. The role will maximise the value of every marketing\-generated lead and build a high\-performance, process\-driven Pre\-Sales function.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Lead Management \& Conversion
   

  

* Own the complete Pre\-Sales funnel from lead allocation and first contact through qualification, follow\-up and site\-visit generation.
* Improve lead contactability, qualification, engagement and site\-visit conversion.
* Monitor lead ageing, untouched leads, follow\-up gaps and lead leakage and drive corrective action. Team Leadership \& Productivity
* Lead, manage and develop the Pre\-Sales team against defined productivity and conversion targets.
* Establish daily and weekly standards covering calls, connect rates, follow\-ups, qualified leads and site visits.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and targeted coaching.


 CRM \& Data Governance
   

  

* Ensure disciplined usage of Sell.Do / CRM.
* Set standards for lead allocation, data capture, lead status, follow\-up scheduling and closure.
* Conduct periodic CRM and data audits and drive CRM\-based reporting. MIS \& Analytics
* Own the Pre\-Sales master tracker, MIS and performance dashboards.
* Track lead volumes, contactability, untouched leads, calls, follow\-ups, qualified leads, site visits and conversion ratios.
* Provide actionable insights and drive corrective action. Sales \& Marketing Collaboration
* Work closely with Marketing on lead quality, campaign effectiveness and source\-wise performance.
* Partner with Sales to ensure smooth handover of qualified leads and effective follow\-through after site visits.
* Establish feedback mechanisms to improve lead quality and conversion.


 Process Excellence \& Customer Experience
   

  

* Standardise calling scripts, qualification frameworks, follow\-up processes and lead\-management SOPs.
* Continuously improve Pre\-Sales processes and customer experience.
* Introduce technology, automation and AI\-led interventions where relevant.


 KEY RESULT AREAS (KRAs)
   

  

* Lead\-to\-Contact Conversion
* Contact\-to\-Qualified Lead Conversion
* Qualified Lead\-to\-Site Visit Conversion
* Overall Lead\-to\-Site Visit Conversion
* Lead Leakage and Lead Ageing
* Untouched / Uncontacted Leads
* Team Productivity – Calls \& Follow\-ups
* CRM / Sell.Do Data Accuracy and Compliance
* Lead Source and Campaign Performance
* Pre\-Sales Team Performance and Target Achievement
* Site\-Visit Quality and Sales Handover
* MIS Accuracy and Timeliness
* Customer Engagement and Response Time


**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**
* 10–15 years in Pre\-Sales, Inside Sales, Tele\-sales, Lead Management or Sales Operations.
* Proven experience leading and scaling a target\-driven Pre\-Sales / Inside Sales team.
* Strong understanding of the real\-estate lead funnel, customer journey and conversion metrics.
* Demonstrated track record of improving lead\-to\-site\-visit and overall funnel conversion.
* Strong hands\-on CRM experience; Sell.Do exposure preferred.
* Strong analytical ability with experience in MIS, funnel analytics and dashboards.
* Experience establishing processes, SOPs, performance standards and CRM governance.
* Strong stakeholder\-management, communication, coaching and people\-management skills.
* High ownership, commercial orientation and execution discipline.

title: Co-Founder | Magma ChargeSpot | Sales, Growth & Business Development | Equity-Only (Pre-Seed)
description:
Please read this entire post before applying. It'll save both of us time.
 



  





*This is not a job.* 




 There is no salary at this stage. If you're looking for a monthly paycheck, this opportunity isn't the right fit.
 



  





 This is also not a side project. If you plan to keep your current job and "see how it goes," we're probably not a good match.
 



  





 I'm looking for someone who wants to build a company from the ground up and is willing to commit to creating something meaningful in exchange for real ownership.
 



  





**About Magma ChargeSpot** 




  





 Magma ChargeSpot is building a smart charging infrastructure platform that enables businesses to offer paid charging services for mobile phones, laptops, electric bikes, EVs, and other electronic devices.
 



  





 Our vision is to build one of India's largest smart charging networks across hotels, restaurants, malls, transport hubs, hospitals, educational institutions, apartments, workplaces, and retail spaces.
 



  





 We're developing our own hardware, embedded software, cloud platform, payment system, and charging management software to create a scalable charging ecosystem.
 



  





 We're currently at the early stage where the decisions we make today will define the company's future.
 



  





**About Me** 




 I'm Anish, Founder of Magma ChargeSpot.
 



 My background is in electronics, embedded systems, IoT, SaaS, and product development. I've built multiple technology ventures, including Firechip Electronics and Firechip Academy. My strength is designing and building products, not sales and marketing.
 



  





 That's why I'm looking for a complementary co\-founder.
 



  





**Who I'm Looking For** 




 Co\-Founder – Sales, Marketing \& Business Development
 



 You'll own the commercial side of the business.
 



  





 Your responsibilities will include:
 



 • Customer acquisition and enterprise sales
 



 • Building partnerships with hotels, malls, hospitals, parking operators, apartments, educational institutions, and corporate campuses
 



 • Brand building and marketing strategy
 



 • Channel and distribution development
 



 • Go\-to\-market strategy
 



 • Revenue growth
 



 • Investor presentations and business development
 



  





**What I'm Looking For** 




 You don't necessarily need experience in the EV industry.
 



  





 I'm looking for someone who:
 


* Loves meeting customers and closing deals
* Has experience in B2B sales or business development
* Can build partnerships from scratch
* Thinks like an owner, not an employee
* Is comfortable with uncertainty and startup life
* Wants to build a large company over the next 10\+ years



  





**What's on the Table** 



* Meaningful founder equity (subject to mutual agreement and standard vesting)
* A true co\-founder role with ownership over the commercial side of the company
* Direct involvement in company strategy, fundraising, and major business decisions
* The opportunity to help build one of India's leading charging infrastructure companies



  





**Expectations** 



* No salary initially
* Full\-time commitment
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings and partnerships
* Preferably based in or willing to relocate to Chennai (flexible for the right person)
* Long\-term commitment



  





**Before You Apply** 




 Please don't apply if:
 


* You're looking for a salaried executive role
* You want to "try it for a few months"
* You're only interested after funding is secured
* You can't commit significant time to building the company



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send me:
 


1. Your resume
2. Your LinkedIn profile
3. A short note explaining why you want to build Magma ChargeSpot
4. How would you acquire our first 100 charging locations if you joined tomorrow



  





 If reading this excites you rather than makes you uncomfortable, I'd love to hear from you.
 



 Let's build something meaningful.
 



  





 — Anish R
 



 Founder, Magma ChargeSpot

 Join Workday’s Growing Team in India
   

  

 Workday is expanding our presence in India, one of our most important growth markets and a key to achieving our APAC ambitions.
