 What’s Driving Our Growth in India
   

  

 We’re making bold investments to better serve our growing customer base, with millions of active users in India and more to come. Our expansion focuses on three key areas:

**Lindstrom Services India Private Limited**

 The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for driving
 **new business acquisition and revenue growth**

* Monitor customer health and take proactive actions to ensure retention



**4\. Market Intelligence \& Business Insights** 



* Stay informed on industry trends, customer expectations, and competitor activities
* Gather and share market insights to support product, pricing, and service improvements
* Contribute to identifying new market opportunities and business segments



**5\. Sales Planning \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of sales activities, pipeline, and forecasts in CRM systems
* Track performance against targets and provide regular updates to stakeholders
* Ensure discipline in sales processes and reporting standards

* **Experience:** 
 Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B / corporate sales
* **Sales Capability:** 
 Proven track record in lead generation, direct sales, and deal closure
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior decision\-makers
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Strong presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
* **Tools \& Systems:** 
 Working knowledge of CRM platforms, MS Office, and digital sales tools

 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred)
* **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel extensively for business development



  





**Key Competencies:** 




**1\. New Business Hunting Mindset** 



* Demonstrates a strong drive to
 **identify and convert new business opportunities**
* Proactively pursues leads and builds a healthy sales pipeline



**2\. Consultative Selling Ability** 



* Understands customer needs and translates them into
 **relevant, value\-driven solutions**
* Moves beyond transactional selling to
 **solution\-based conversations**



**3\. Stakeholder Influence \& Relationship Building** 



* Builds credibility and trust with
 **senior decision\-makers (Plant Heads, Procurement, etc.)**

**4\. Commercial Acumen** 



* Understands pricing, margins, and business impact
* Negotiates effectively while ensuring
 **win\-win outcomes**



**5\. Execution Discipline** 



* Maintains strong control over
 **sales pipeline, follow\-ups, and closures**
* Demonstrates consistency in achieving targets and meeting deadlines



**6\. Market Awareness \& Adaptability** 



* Stays updated on
 **industry trends, competition, and customer expectations**
* Adapts sales approach based on market dynamics

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 IECHM Technology Private Limited is a one\-stop OEM manufacturer based in Chennai, India, specializing in taking product ideas from concept to mass production under one roof. The company manages the complete product development cycle on its own machines, with no outside vendors or handoffs. IECHM offers free design, engineering, and consultation services, supporting clients from initial idea or sketch through 3D modeling, custom electronics, simulation, and validation. The organization manufactures products across sectors other than chemical and textile, allowing partners to engage at any stage, from prototype to full production. IECHM is focused on turning ideas into high\-quality, real\-world products through integrated concept, design, engineering, and manufacturing capabilities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time remote role for a Field Sales Executive at IECHM Technology Private Limited. The Field Sales Executive will identify and qualify prospective clients, build and maintain relationships, and promote IECHM’s end\-to\-end OEM manufacturing services. Daily responsibilities include conducting virtual and field\-based meetings, presenting solutions based on client needs, preparing proposals and quotations, and following up to close opportunities. The role involves coordinating closely with internal engineering and production teams to align customer requirements with feasible solutions and timelines. The Field Sales Executive will also track sales activities, maintain accurate CRM records, provide market feedback, and contribute to sales targets and revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Sales and business development skills, including lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, and closing deals.
* Customer relationship management skills, such as stakeholder communication, account management, and post\-sales support.
* Understanding of manufacturing or engineering services, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear value propositions.
* Strong presentation, documentation, and proposal\-writing skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Comfort with remote work tools, CRM systems, and digital collaboration platforms.
* Relevant experience in field sales or B2B sales, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work independently, travel as needed to client sites, and manage time and territory effectively.
* Professional communication skills in English; additional regional language skills are an advantage.

title: Telesales Executive
description:

 DETRON India CNC Rotary Tables is associated with detron Machinery Co. Ltd., Taiwan, one of the world’s largest professional rotary table manufacturers. detron focuses on designing and engineering high\-quality NC rotary table products, driven by an experienced international R\&D team. The company’s mission is to understand and support customer needs through advanced application technology and a wide range of products that deliver optimum performance. Intelligent design ensures easy integration of their rotary tables with diverse machine tools, enabling efficient and reliable manufacturing solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time Telesales Executive role is an on\-site position based in Chennai. The Telesales Executive will make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers to promote CNC rotary tables and related solutions, explain product features, and understand customer requirements. The role involves generating and qualifying leads, maintaining accurate records of interactions in the CRM system, and following up consistently to convert opportunities into sales. The Telesales Executive will respond to inquiries, coordinate with the sales and technical teams for quotations or product demonstrations, and contribute to achieving individual and team sales targets. The position also includes providing basic customer support over the phone and sharing customer feedback to improve service and product offerings.

title: Structural Steel Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 SISCOL (Steel Infra Solutions Company Limited) delivers end\-to\-end structural steel solutions that support India’s key infrastructure projects, including airports, metro systems, bridges, seaports, high\-rise buildings, and industrial hubs. Led by experienced professionals from the steel and infrastructure sectors, the company focuses on precision, faster build times, design flexibility, and sustainability. SISCOL operates state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Bhilai, Hyderabad, and Vadodara, along with design and engineering centers in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, and Bhilai. The organization is committed to delivering projects to global standards across India, positioning structural steel at the center of modern infrastructure. SISCOL’s mission is to help build a stronger, smarter, and faster\-growing India through innovative steel solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Structural Steel Sales Engineer role based in Chennai. The role involves identifying and pursuing sales opportunities for structural steel solutions, managing client relationships, and preparing technical and commercial proposals. The Sales Engineer will collaborate with design, engineering, and project teams to translate client requirements into feasible technical solutions and ensure accurate quotations. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting site visits, providing pre\- and post\-sales technical support, delivering product presentations, and participating in negotiations to close orders. The role also includes maintaining CRM records, tracking market trends, and supporting business development initiatives to expand SISCOL’s presence in the region.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills, with the ability to interpret structural steel designs and specifications.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Customer Service skills to build relationships, manage accounts, and ensure client satisfaction.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for presenting solutions, coordinating with internal teams, and preparing clear documentation.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience in structural steel, construction, or infrastructure projects will be an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site with clients and project teams, including occasional travel as required.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with basic engineering drawings or CAD tools is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving abilities, with a focus on achieving sales targets ethically and collaboratively.

title: Sales Account Executive
description:
**About Chargebee** 




 Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
 



  





 Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2\.
 



 With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.
 



  





**About the role (Job Summary)** 




 You'll be talking to founders. Early\-stage, fast\-moving, often pre\-revenue. They've booked a meeting with us because they know billing is a problem they need to solve. Your job is to confirm that, show them exactly what they need to see, and close.
 



  





**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)** 



* Running inbound discovery and closing calls with early\-stage startup founders across the US and EMEA — companies with fewer than 10 employees, often pre\-revenue or under $100K ARR.
* Qualifying prospects fast, identifying the right offer, and closing deals in one call wherever possible.
* Working multiple lead sources — inbound demo bookings, form applications, high\-growth trial accounts, and warm handoffs — each with a different approach.
* Positioning Chargebee not as a product but as growth infrastructure — something founders set up once and grow into, not something that slows them down.
* Handling objections with clarity and confidence, not scripts — especially the tough ones around pricing, complexity, and why not just use the free plan.
* Managing a high volume of accounts without losing the personal touch that closes early\-stage founders.



  





**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)** 




  




* You have a good grasp of the product — you don't need to be an expert on every feature, but you understand what we solve and for whom
* You have 2\-4 years of work experience
* Good problem solving skills — ability to simplify complex problems and provide solution to the customers
* Understand what a good customer conversation looks like
* You can run a focused, story\-driven conversation — you sell the outcome, not the feature list
* You're comfortable making quick decisions — which offer to lead with, when to push, when to listen
* You write clearly and concisely — a lot of this motion runs on sharp emails that move deals forward without scheduling unnecessary calls
* You manage your time well independently — this is a high\-volume role and things move fast

 What we're looking for
 



 • B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (a related diploma with

 What you get

 • Direct access to the founders and a real say in how we grow in South India
 



 • Technical training on ECOTREAT from the team that designs and builds it
 



 • Travel and mobile allowance as per policy
 



  





 Locations :
 



 Hyderabad and Bangalore (one position per city)

 Send your CV to jacob@susbio.in and akshat@susbio.in with the subject line "Sales Engineer,
 



 \[Hyderabad/Bangalore]".

 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.

**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

 MedTech Sales

**Job Category**
 Professional

 Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, PENJERLA, Telangana, India
   

  

**Job Description**
 About DePuy Synthes
   

  

 At DePuy Synthes, we are transforming orthopaedic care through intelligent technologies, data\-driven insights, and robotic\-assisted surgery. As part of Johnson \& Johnson MedTech, we are committed to advancing patient outcomes through innovation, education, and clinical excellence.
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery platforms, collaborate with renowned surgeons, and contribute to the adoption of next\-generation surgical technologies. We provide world\-class training, professional development, and a dynamic environment where high performers can build a rewarding career.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The District account manager – Digital Surgery is responsible for driving adoption and utilization of Digital Surgery solutions, including robotic\-assisted surgery platforms, navigation technologies, and data\-enabled surgical workflows within the assigned territory.
   

  

 The role focuses on executing surgeon conversion strategies, developing customer partnerships, supporting clinical excellence, and achieving sales and utilization targets. The District account manager will collaborate closely with Joint Reconstruction sales teams, marketing, clinical specialists, and hospital stakeholders to accelerate the adoption of Smart Surgery solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Business Development \& Sales Growth
   

  

* Drive sales growth and market expansion of Digital Surgery solutions within the assigned territory.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to increase adoption of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies.
* Identify, prioritize, and convert target surgeons, hospitals, and healthcare systems through structured conversion plans.
* Achieve or exceed assigned sales, utilization, and market development targets.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of opportunities and maintain accurate forecasting.


 Surgeon Engagement \& Customer Development
   

  

* Establish strong relationships with key orthopaedic surgeons, hospital administrators, theatre managers, and clinical teams.
* Drive surgeon conversions through evidence\-based discussions, clinical value propositions, and workflow optimization.
* Support surgeon onboarding and adoption programs to ensure successful technology implementation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by demonstrating clinical, operational, and economic value.


 Clinical \& Technical Support
   

  

* Provide in\-theatre support during robotic\-assisted procedures and technology\-enabled surgeries.
* Deliver product demonstrations, workshops, and educational programs for surgeons and operating room staff.
* Ensure customers are trained and confident in the utilization of Digital Surgery technologies.
* Collaborate with Clinical Specialists to maximize utilization and customer satisfaction.


 Strategic Account Management
   

  

* Develop territory business plans aligned with regional and national objectives.
* Monitor competitive activities, market trends, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities.
* Drive capital equipment opportunities through effective stakeholder engagement and value\-based selling.
* Support contract negotiations, business reviews, and technology utilization assessments.


 Cross\-functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner closely with Joint Reconstruction Sales, Marketing, Clinical Education, Professional Education, and Service teams.
* Support product launches, customer education initiatives, and strategic marketing programs.
* Contribute to best\-practice sharing and continuous improvement initiatives across the Digital Surgery business.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Achievement of Digital Surgery sales targets.
* Surgeon conversion and adoption metrics.
* Robotic utilization growth.
* New account acquisition and account penetration.
* Customer satisfaction and retention.
* Market share growth within assigned territory.
* Training and education program effectiveness.
* Forecast accuracy and pipeline development.


**Essential**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Physiotherapy, Healthcare, Business, or related discipline.
* Demonstrated success in medical device, healthcare technology, orthopaedics, or capital equipment sales.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and highly technical environment.
* Strong business acumen and analytical mindset.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Preferred**
* Experience in Orthopaedics, Joint Reconstruction, Surgical Navigation, Robotics, Digital Health, or Operating Theatre environments.
* Experience supporting surgeons during surgical procedures.
* Knowledge of robotic\-assisted surgery technologies and healthcare digital transformation.
* Experience influencing multiple stakeholders in complex hospital sales environments.


 Desired Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Thinking
* Customer Centricity
* Commercial Excellence
* Technical Aptitude
* Clinical Credibility
* Influencing \& Negotiation Skills
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration \& Teamwork
* Adaptability and Resilience
* Results Orientation


 Why Join Us?
   

  

* Work with industry\-leading robotic and digital surgery technologies.
* Comprehensive onboarding and world\-class training programs.
* Opportunities for rapid career growth within Johnson \& Johnson MedTech.
* Competitive compensation and incentive programs.
* Collaborative and inclusive culture.
* Access to award\-winning leadership development programs.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on surgeon outcomes and patient care.


**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
 Account Management, Business Behavior, Collaboration, Cultural Competence, Customer Analytics, Customer Centricity, Execution Focus, Healthcare Trends, Issue Escalation, Market Knowledge, Market Research, Medical Technology, Sales, Sales Support, Solutions Selling, Sustainable Procurement, Vendor Selection

title: Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

 systems that make our best stores the benchmark for the network.

 handoff into our training team.

 adopt a retention playbook (comp, incentives, career path) rather than owning the
   

  

 outcome directly.

 underperforming stores.

 stores grow.

title: SaaS Sales Specialist (North America)
description:
**About Credibled** 




  





 Credibled is a Canadian owned background screening platform headquartered in Toronto. Staffing agencies, recruitment firms and employers use us to run criminal record checks, reference checks, identity verification and social media screening in minutes instead of days. We are founder led, bootstrapped and growing.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are hiring a 360 SaaS Sales Specialist to own outbound sales into Canada and the United States from our Chennai office. You build the pipeline, run the discovery calls, demo the product, close the business, and then keep the account. Every client you sign stays yours.
 



  





 Giving small and mid sized clients a real human point of contact is one of the reasons they choose us over the large enterprise providers. That only works if the person who sold the account is the person who supports it. So this role owns both.
 



  





 This is a closing role with a quota. It is not lead generation for someone else to close.
 



 You will report to Credibled's sales leadership in Toronto and work directly with the founders. You will be employed through our Chennai partner, Bumsa Talent Solutions Pvt. Ltd., and based in their Chennai office.
 



  





**New business** 



* Build pipeline through cold calling, email, LinkedIn and Sales Navigator
* Qualify prospects and diagnose how they screen candidates today
* Run product demos that connect Credibled to the prospect's actual hiring workflow
* Own the full sales cycle from first contact through negotiation and signed business
* Prepare proposals and quotations
* Hit monthly and quarterly targets on new accounts and check volume



  





**Account ownership** 



* Onboard every client you close and get them running their first checks
* Act as the named point of contact for your accounts and respond to day to day questions
* Train new users at your accounts as their teams change
* Watch usage across your book and step in when an account goes quiet
* Grow accounts by introducing additional check types they are not yet using
* Re\-engage dormant accounts and bring them back into regular usage
* Handle renewals, pricing conversations and escalations for your own clients



  





**Operating** 



* Keep prospect, deal and account data accurate in the CRM
* Report weekly on pipeline, activity, forecast and account health
* Work with the Toronto team on anything that needs product or operations support
* Feed competitor and market intelligence back to the product team



  





**What you need** 



* 5\+ years in B2B SaaS sales carrying a closing quota
* Experience owning accounts after the sale, not just handing them off
* Proven track record selling to North American customers in the US, Canada or both
* Strong outbound skills. You are comfortable dialling and you do not wait for inbound
* Demonstrated ability to run a complete B2B sales cycle independently
* Confident running product demos and converting prospects into paying customers
* Strong negotiation, objection handling and closing skills
* Excellent spoken and written English, including with senior decision makers
* Hands on CRM experience
* Willing and able to work a straight night shift aligned to North American business hours



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience selling HR tech, recruitment tech, background verification, reference checking, ATS or HRMS
* Experience in a 360 or full cycle role where you carried both new business and an existing book
* Understanding of the US and Canadian B2B technology buying process
* Experience selling to HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment or Operations leaders
* Experience with Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce or LinkedIn Sales Navigator



  





**Who this is not for** 




 Appointment setters and lead generation only profiles. Equally, this is not a pure account management seat. You need to be able to do both. We will ask for your quota, your attainment and the details of your last closed deal.
 



  





**Shift and location** 



* Straight night shift aligned to North American business hours. On site in Chennai, Guindy, Tamil Nadu.

title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Chennai)
description:
**About The Team**
 We are building a high\-performance Revenue \& Marketing pod — a geography\-focused business unit that owns end\-to\-end top\-line and bottom\-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
   

  

 This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data\-fluent, and thrive in a fast\-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Revenue \& P\&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P\&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course\-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth \& Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first\-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install\-not\-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in\-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on\-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end\-to\-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high\-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence \& Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in\-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data\-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health \& Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock\-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop\-offs — with revenue\-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics \& Reporting
* Maintain a real\-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions


**Who We Are Looking For**
 Must Have
   

  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution \[IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e\-commerce operations, or P\&L\-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross\-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment


 Good to Have
   

  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e\-commerce, Q\-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on\-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in\-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell\-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on\-ground activation


**What We Offer**
* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P\&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High\-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Manager - Business Development & Liaisoning
description:
**PACIFICA COMPANIES** 




*Job Description* 




**About Pacifica Companies** 




 Founded in 1978 by Chairman Mr. Ash (Ashok) Israni, Pacifica Companies is a privately held, vertically integrated global real estate conglomerate headquartered in the USA, with a workforce of 9,000\+ people worldwide. Operating across 22 American states and, since expanding into India in 2004, across Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Dwarka and NCR, Pacifica has built a legacy of landmark developments spanning residential communities, commercial and mixed\-use spaces, hospitality, IT parks, townships, plotted developments and senior living — all delivered on a foundation of trust, quality and ethics.
 



 In India, Pacifica's portfolio includes projects such as Hillcrest (Hyderabad), San Tropez and Pacifica One (Vadodara), Aurum Villas and Pride Towers (Chennai), and Hamilton Tower (Bengaluru), reflecting its philosophy of “creating value where others don't look” — identifying undervalued opportunities and transforming them into market\-defining benchmarks. The company is guided by strong values around elevating quality of life for residents and communities, environmental responsibility, and disciplined, accountable execution, and continues to expand its footprint across India's major growth corridors.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




**Position Title** 




 Manager / Senior Manager – Business Development \& Liaisoning
 



**Department** 




 Business Development \& Land Acquisition
 



**Location** 




 Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 



**Reporting Office** 




 Pacifica Aurum, Rajiv Gandhi Salai (Old Mahabalipuram Road), Padur, Chennai – 603103
 



**Industry** 




 Real Estate Development – Residential, Commercial \& Mixed\-Use
 



**Experience Required** 




 8\+ years (Manager) · 10\+ years (Sr. Manager) in real estate land acquisition, BD \& liaisoning
 



**Education** 




 Minimum Graduate in any stream (Civil Engineering / Law (LLB) / Real Estate Management / MBA preferred)
 



**Compensation** 




 Best in industry, commensurate with experience and seniority level
 








 Pacifica Companies is hiring a Manager / Senior Manager / General Manager – Business Development, Legal \& Liaisoning for its Chennai operations, based at the Pacifica Aurum project office. This is a field\-intensive, relationship\-driven role at the front end of the real estate development lifecycle — responsible for identifying and securing land parcels for the company's residential and mixed\-use pipeline, and for driving every legal, revenue and statutory approval needed to convert a sourced parcel into a construction\-ready asset. The role requires an established local network of landowners, brokers, advocates and government officials, sound commercial judgement, and the persistence to navigate multi\-department, multi\-authority government processes end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Land Identification \& Business Development** 




**•** 
 Identify and evaluate potential land parcels for acquisition — outright purchase, Joint Development Agreement (JDA), or Joint Venture (JV) — in Chennai and other target micro\-markets, in line with the company's investment criteria.
 



**•** 
 Build and continuously expand a strong network of landowners, brokers, local influencers and industry contacts to generate a healthy, ongoing pipeline of land opportunities.
 



**•** 
 Conduct preliminary market research and site visits to assess location viability, connectivity, surrounding infrastructure and competing developments.
 



**•** 
 Prepare land valuation reports, benchmarking the asking price against comparable market transactions.
 



**•** 
 Prepare project workability and feasibility studies covering permissible FSI/FAR, development potential, saleable\-area estimates and preliminary cost\-revenue projections.
 



**•** 
 Support preparation of Information Memorandums (IMs) and investment proposals for management / Investment Committee review and approval.
 



**•** 
 Lead commercial negotiations with landowners on pricing, payment terms and deal structure (outright sale vs. JDA/JV revenue\- or area\-sharing arrangements).
 



**2\. Legal \& Title Due Diligence** 




**•** 
 Coordinate legal scrutiny of shortlisted land parcels with empanelled advocates/legal counsel, including title search, encumbrance verification and chain\-of\-title review.
 



**•** 
 Oversee verification of registered property title documents, patta/chitta records, FMB sketches and other land records to confirm marketable, disputable\-free title.
 



**•** 
 Identify and flag title defects, litigation or ownership disputes, and coordinate with legal advisors on resolution and mitigation strategies before deal closure.
 



**•** 
 Support drafting, review and execution of Sale Deeds, Joint Development Agreements, Power of Attorney and other land\-related legal documents in coordination with legal counsel.
 



**•** 
 Ensure compliance with the Transfer of Property Act, the Registration Act, applicable Tamil Nadu land and revenue laws, and RERA (Tamil Nadu) requirements throughout the acquisition lifecycle.
 



**3\. Land Possession, Registration \& Revenue Liaison** 




**•** 
 Coordinate taking physical and legal possession of acquired land parcels.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate registration of properties with the Sub\-Registrar's office, ensuring accurate documentation and timely completion of stamp duty and registration formalities.
 



**•** 
 Liaise with the District Revenue Office, Inspector General of Registration, Taluk Office, Revenue Divisional Office, Collectorate and Directorate of Land Administration for land\-related clearances, conversions and record updates.
 



**•** 
 Liaise with relevant departments at the State Secretariat as required for policy\-level approvals and escalations.
 



**•** 
 Track and interpret evolving government policies, land regulations and municipal/town\-planning norms that may impact ongoing or planned acquisitions, and proactively advise management on implications.
 



**4\. Statutory \& Regulatory Approvals** 




**•** 
 Coordinate with advocates and consultants to obtain and track approvals required for land acquisition and project development.
 



**•** 
 Drive the end\-to\-end approval process with: CMDA (Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority), DTCP (Directorate of Town and Country Planning), CMWSSB (Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board), local bodies (Corporation / Municipality / Panchayat), TNEB, Police Department, Fire \& Rescue Services, Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board, and other statutory/regulatory authorities as applicable.
 



**•** 
 Maintain a live tracker/MIS of approval status, pending queries and target timelines across all authorities and projects, and escalate delays proactively.
 



**•** 
 Build and sustain professional relationships with officials across these departments to facilitate smoother, faster processing of applications.
 



**5\. Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Coordination** 




**•** 
 Act as the primary point of contact between landowners/brokers and internal teams (Projects, Legal, Finance, Design, Sales) throughout the acquisition and approval lifecycle.
 



**•** 
 Coordinate handover of acquired land parcels and approval documentation to the Projects/Technical team for design and execution.
 



**•** 
 Work closely with the Finance team on acquisition\-related budgeting, including stamp duty, registration charges, professional fees and other statutory costs.
 



**•** 
 Represent the company professionally in all external dealings with landowners, brokers, consultants and government officials, upholding Pacifica's reputation for trust, quality and ethics.
 



**6\. Reporting, Documentation \& Team Leadership** 




**•** 
 Maintain accurate, organized records (physical and digital) of all land documents, approvals, correspondence and agreements for each project/parcel.
 



**•** 
 Prepare periodic reports/dashboards for senior management on land pipeline status, deal progress and approval timelines.
 



**•** 
 (Sr. Manager / GM) Mentor, guide and review the work of junior BD \& Liaison executives; allocate parcels and approvals across the team, and ensure quality and timeliness of execution.
 



**•** 
 (GM) Own the overall BD \& Liaisoning function for the Chennai region across multiple projects, define land\-acquisition strategy in line with company growth plans, and represent the function at the senior leadership level.
 



  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




 •     Strong, existing network of landowners, brokers and government officials across the Chennai / Tamil Nadu real estate market.
 



**•** 
 In\-depth working knowledge of CMDA, DTCP, CMWSSB, local body, TNEB, Fire, Police and Pollution Control Board approval processes.
 



**•** 
 Working knowledge of the Transfer of Property Act, the Registration Act, RERA (Tamil Nadu) and applicable land revenue laws.
 



**•** 
 Strong negotiation, deal\-structuring and commercial acumen.
 



**•** 
 Ability to read and interpret title documents, survey sketches (FMB) and patta/chitta records.
 



**•** 
 Excellent stakeholder\-management and interpersonal skills; equally comfortable engaging landowners, brokers, advocates and government officials.
 



**•** 
 High level of diplomacy, patience and persistence in navigating multi\-department government processes.
 



**•** 
 Strong documentation, MIS and reporting discipline; proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
 



**•** 
 Fluency in Tamil is essential; working proficiency in English required, Hindi an added advantage.
 



**•** 
 High personal integrity and ethical standards, in line with Pacifica's values.
 



**•** 
 Willingness to travel extensively across project sites and government offices within Chennai and Tamil Nadu.
 



  





**What Pacifica Offers** 




**•** 
 Exposure to landmark residential, commercial, hospitality and township developments across India's key growth corridors.
 



**•** 
 A genuine career growth path from Manager to Senior Manager to General Manager within the BD \& Liaisoning function.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates may share their profile with:
 



**Mr. Vishal Raval, Sr. Manager – Human Capital** 




 Email: vraval@pacificacompanies.com
 



 Company Websites: www.pacificacompanies.co.in \| www.pacificacompanies.com \| www.pacificahost.com \| www.pacificaseniorliving.com
 


* Corporate Profile: http://www.pacificacompanies.co.in/public/wp/corporate\-profile/mobile/html5forpc.html

The role ensures timely and accurate quote generation, coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to obtain operational and pricing approvals, identifies process improvement opportunities, and delivers an exceptional customer experience while driving quoting efficiency and operational excellence.

 ****,****

* MBA from a Tier\-1 or Tier\-2 business school.

title: Territory Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 FACE Prep is one of India’s largest placement\-focused skill development companies, specializing in job preparation for the tech sector. Since 2008, it has helped millions of students launch their careers through structured training and targeted preparation programs. FACE Prep offers masterclasses, self\-paced courses, workshops, and bootcamps designed to build the skills required for high\-paying tech roles. Its alumni work in leading global technology companies such as Google, Microsoft, Meta, Adobe, PayPal, Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Thoughtworks, Cognizant, and Accenture. The organization continues to expand its impact by partnering with institutions and employers to improve placement outcomes.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Territory Sales Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai, responsible for driving sales growth and partnerships within an assigned region. In this position, the individual will identify and engage colleges, training institutes, and corporate partners, pitch FACE Prep’s programs, and close deals to meet revenue and expansion targets. The role involves building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, conducting presentations and product demonstrations, and providing ongoing support to client institutions to ensure satisfaction and retention. The Territory Sales Manager will also collect market intelligence, track competition, contribute to sales strategy, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth implementation of training and placement solutions. Regular travel within the territory, performance reporting, and participation in promotional events and training sessions are integral parts of this role.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage stakeholders, deliver presentations, and manage client relationships effectively.
* Candidates should possess proven Sales capabilities, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing, to achieve territory revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess Sales Management skills to plan territory strategies, forecast demand, and track performance metrics.
* Candidates should possess Training\-related skills to coordinate or facilitate sessions and articulate FACE Prep’s learning solutions to institutions and learners.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple accounts, and travel within the assigned territory as needed.

* Comfort with digital tools, CRM systems, and data\-driven decision\-making will be an advantage.

description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Wellness Consultant to own and convert inbound enquiries for our recovery equipment portfolio.
 



 Leads come to you — your job is to qualify them with precision, understand the buyer's facility or training context deeply, and guide them to a confident purchase decision.
 



 This is not a cold\-calling role. It is a consultative, high\-touch sales seat where your familiarity with the wellness world is what earns the buyer's trust.
 



 Our buyers are gym owners, coaches, physiotherapists, hotel and spa wellness heads, and serious individual athletes. They speak the language of training, recovery and performance, and they buy from people who speak it back.
 



 If you have worked in this industry and care about where it is going, you start this role with an advantage no generalist salesperson can match.
 



 We will teach you the product and the protocols — what we cannot teach is genuine interest in wellness.
 



 This is a high\-ownership seat. You will own your numbers, your pipeline and your mistakes, with no one chasing you.
 



 It is demanding, and not everyone lasts. If that is the environment where you do your best work — and you want the recognition and the chance to make your name in the wellness and longevity industry — we want to talk to you.
 



  





**What you'll do \-** 



* Receive, qualify, and prioritise inbound enquiries across our product range — ice baths, infrared saunas, and red light therapy panels.
* Run discovery calls and video consultations to understand the buyer's space, member or client profile, use case, and decision timeline.
* Advise buyers on the right configuration for their facility or home setup, and explain the outcomes and protocols behind it credibly.
* Own the sales cycle end to end — qualification, proposal, follow\-up, negotiation, and order closure.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of every interaction, lead stage, and deal status in Zoho CRM.
* Coordinate with the installation and customer success team for a seamless post\-sale handover.
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within inbound enquiries and existing accounts.
* Share structured feedback on lead quality, common objections, and buyer patterns with the marketing and product team.
* Represent Biotastic at gyms, industry events, trade shows, and wellness summits to build visibility and generate leads.
* Track competitor activity, pricing movements, and client feedback; share structured market intelligence with the team.



  





**What we are looking for \-** 



* **Industry background** 
 — you come from wellness, fitness or recovery in Chennai: a gym or fitness studio, a fitness or wellness equipment dealer, a physiotherapy or sports rehab centre, or a sports nutrition brand — Fitness One, Skale, O2 Health Studio, Anytime Fitness, Gold's Gym, ReLiva or similar. We are looking for the health and performance side of wellness, not beauty, salon or aesthetic services.
* **Genuine interest in health, fitness and recovery** 
 — you follow where this industry is going and can talk about it without being briefed first.
* **Sales, consultative, or client\-facing experience** 
 — years matter less than your track record of persuading people and closing. Be ready to substantiate with numbers or specifics.
* **Comfortable learning technical product detail** 
 — cold and heat exposure, recovery protocols, and what the evidence supports. We will train you on this.
* **Excellent communication and presentation skills** 
 in both English and Hindi.
* **Consultative selling instinct** 
 — you listen first, ask the right questions, and advise rather than push.
* **Comfortable with a CRM tool** 
 and willing to maintain rigorous daily data hygiene in Zoho CRM.



  





**Good to have \-** 



* Prior experience selling gym or fitness equipment, wellness services, memberships, or premium hospitality.
* Experience with high\-consideration purchases where the buyer needs education, trust, and time before committing.
* Experience selling capital equipment, turnkey installations, or premium experiential products.



  





**What we offer \-** 



* A front\-row seat in India's recovery and longevity category while it is still being built — and the recognition that comes with helping build it.
* A product portfolio that genuinely sells itself to the right buyers — premium, differentiated, and backed by science.
* Employee wellness benefits including gym subsidy, annual health checkup, and an AI upskilling budget.
* A fast\-moving, founder\-led environment with clear scope to grow into a regional or vertical leadership role

title: Sales Manager
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Role:Sales Manager
   

  

 A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single\-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative \& On\-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field\-intensive engagement: Conduct in\-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data\-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course\-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day\-to\-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In\-person meetings with restaurant partners a month


**Qualifications**
 What We're Looking For Experience \& Background:
   

  

* 0\-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round\-the\-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post \- Graduated preferably in marketing or sales


**Additional Information**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

 About Meshfloor
 
 Meshfloor is a SaaS platform built for coworking spaces and managed office operators.
 



 It helps operators manage their workspace operations, customers, memberships, quotations, agreements, invoicing, collections, occupancy, meeting rooms, leads and other day\-to\-day business processes from one platform.
 



 We are now looking for our
 **first dedicated sales hire** 
 to help us acquire coworking and managed\-office operators across India.
 



 This is a founding sales role. You will have significant ownership of building the sales pipeline, conducting product demonstrations, converting prospects and helping new customers get started with Meshfloor.
 


 What you will do1\. Identify potential customers
 
 Build a database of coworking and managed\-office operators across India using:
 


* LinkedIn
* Google
* Industry directories
* Real\-estate networks
* Coworking communities
* Business databases
* Direct prospecting



 Identify decision makers such as founders, owners, directors and operations heads.
 


 2\. Cold calling and outreach
 
 Contact prospects through:
 


* Phone calls
* WhatsApp
* Email
* LinkedIn
* Other appropriate B2B channels



 Understand how the operator currently manages their business and identify opportunities where Meshfloor can help.
 


 3\. Conduct product demos
 
 Schedule and conduct online product demonstrations with prospective customers.
 



 The demo should be consultative rather than simply showing product features.
 



 You should be able to understand the operator's problems and demonstrate how Meshfloor can improve areas such as:
 


* Workspace operations
* Lead management
* Customer onboarding
* Quotations
* Agreements
* Billing and invoicing
* Payment collections
* Occupancy management
* Meeting room management
* Reporting
* Multi\-location operations


 4\. Follow up and close
 
 Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact to payment.
 



 This includes:
 


* Lead qualification
* Demo scheduling
* Follow\-ups
* Proposal/quotation discussions
* Pricing discussions
* Negotiation
* Closing
* Customer handover/onboarding


 5\. Customer onboarding
 
 Assist new operators with their initial Meshfloor setup and help them start using the platform.
 



 You will work closely with the product team to understand customer requirements and communicate feedback for product improvements.
 


 Who we are looking for
 
 We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in
 **commercial real estate, coworking, managed offices or PropTech** 
 .
 



 Ideal candidates may have worked in:
 


* Coworking companies
* Managed office companies
* Commercial real estate
* Corporate office leasing
* Property management
* PropTech companies
* Real\-estate technology
* B2B SaaS companies selling to businesses


 Required skills
 * 2–5 years of sales/business development experience
* Strong cold\-calling ability
* Experience dealing with business owners or senior decision makers
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations
* Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend solutions
* Strong follow\-up discipline
* Comfortable working with CRM systems
* Comfortable with phone, WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn outreach
* Target\-oriented and self\-driven


 Strongly preferred
 
 Experience selling to or working with:
 



**Coworking spaces \| Managed offices \| Commercial real estate \| Property management \| PropTech \| B2B SaaS** 




 Experience with SaaS products such as CRM, ERP, accounting, HRMS, property\-management or workspace\-management software will be an advantage.
 


 What we are NOT looking for
 
 This is not a traditional telecalling role.
 



 We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is simply making a high volume of calls from a predefined script.
 



 We are looking for someone who can:
 



**Find prospects → Understand their business → Conduct a demo → Sell the solution → Close the customer → Help onboard them.** 



 Compensation
 
**₹40,000–₹50,000 per month fixed** 
 , depending on experience and capability.
 



 Additional
 **performance\-based sales incentives** 
 will be provided for qualified demos, new customer acquisition and revenue generated.
 



 The final compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated sales ability.

 * Join at an early stage and become part of the founding sales team
* Work directly with the founder/product team
* Significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunity to build the sales process from the ground up
* Performance\-based earning potential
* Opportunity to grow into a Sales Manager / Business Development leadership role as Meshfloor expands across India


 How to apply
 
 Please share your CV along with a brief summary of:
 


1. Your experience in real estate, coworking, managed offices, PropTech or SaaS
2. What type of products/services you have previously sold
3. Your typical sales cycle
4. Your previous sales targets and achievements
5. Why you believe you would be a good fit for selling Meshfloor

title: Partnerships & Community Associate
description:
**Location:** 

 Chennai
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience:** 

 2 to 4 years
 




  





**About Wualt** 





 Wualt is building a new category at the intersection of women's safety, wellness and technology.
 





 As we move towards our product pilot and launch, we're looking for a Partnerships \& Community Associate to help build the relationships, community and momentum around the brand.
 





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys meeting people, creating opportunities and getting things done. You'll work across partnerships, community, creators, content and marketing operations, with plenty of room to take ownership and shape how Wualt grows.
 




  





**The Role** 





 As Partnerships \& Community Associate, you will be responsible for identifying and building relationships with relevant brands, communities, creators and organisations, while also supporting the day\-to\-day execution of Wualt's marketing initiatives.
 





 You'll be expected to take things from
 
**"this could be interesting" to "let's make it happen."** 




  






 This is not a traditional social media role.
 




  






 We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised, a strong communicator and comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 




*Partnerships \& Outreach* 



* Research and identify relevant brands, communities, creators, organisations and collaboration opportunities
* Build and maintain a partnership pipeline
* Identify the right contacts and decision\-makers
* Conduct email, LinkedIn and social outreach
* Manage follow\-ups and ongoing conversations
* Schedule meetings and coordinate introductions
* Support partnership proposals and negotiations
* Coordinate agreed partnership deliverables
* Maintain relationships with existing partners
* Identify opportunities for co\-marketing, events and collaborations



  





*Community* 



* Manage Instagram DMs and community conversations
* Respond to comments and queries
* Engage with relevant communities and conversations
* Identify opportunities to introduce Wualt to new communities
* Support community initiatives and activations
* Gather audience feedback and insights
* Identify potential community advocates and brand champions
* Share recurring audience questions, feedback and objections with the wider team



  





*Creator \& UGC Coordination* 



* Research relevant creators and content creators
* Build and maintain a creator database
* Conduct creator outreach
* Coordinate briefs, timelines and deliverables
* Manage communication with creators
* Follow up on pending content
* Coordinate revisions where required
* Track content usage and deliverables
* Maintain an organised library of creator content




 You should be comfortable managing several creator conversations simultaneously and keeping projects moving without constant supervision.
 




  





*Content Operations* 





 You'll support the execution of Wualt's content calendar and production pipeline.
 





 This includes:
 



* Coordinating content shoots
* Scheduling people and locations
* Coordinating with photographers, videographers and editors
* Managing production timelines
* Organising content assets
* Maintaining the content calendar
* Coordinating approvals
* Scheduling and publishing content
* Ensuring agreed content goes live on time




 You don't need to be the person developing every creative idea, but you should be able to understand a brief and execute it accurately.
 




  





*Events \& Activations* 





 Support the planning and execution of Wualt's events and offline activations.
 





 This includes:
 



* Researching relevant events and opportunities
* Identifying potential event partners
* Outreach and coordination
* Venue and vendor coordination
* Partner communication
* Attendee coordination
* Managing event checklists and timelines
* Supporting on\-ground execution
* Coordinating post\-event follow\-ups



  





*Marketing Operations* 





 A big part of this role will be keeping things organised.
 





 You'll help manage:
 



* Marketing calendars
* Partnership trackers
* Creator databases
* Campaign trackers
* Content production timelines
* Event trackers
* Deliverables
* Follow\-ups
* Internal coordination




 You'll often be the person making sure that the right person has the right information at the right time.
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Strong communication skills: You're comfortable speaking to people across email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram and calls.
* Proactive mindset: You don't wait around for instructions when you can figure out the next step yourself.
* Excellent follow\-through: You know that sending one email isn't outreach. You follow up, keep conversations warm and close loops.
* Organisation: You can manage multiple partnerships, creators, events and content requirements without losing track.
* Resourcefulness: If one route doesn't work, you find another.
* Relationship\-building: You're naturally good at building rapport and maintaining relationships over time.
* Curiosity: You're interested in people, communities, culture, brands and why people engage with things.
* Startup mindset: You're comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities and being involved in things outside a traditional job description.



  





**Experience** 




**2 to 4 years of relevant experience** 

 is preferred.
 





 Experience in any of the following would be valuable:
 



* Partnerships
* Community management
* Creator/influencer marketing
* Brand marketing
* Events
* Startup marketing
* D2C
* Consumer technology
* Wellness
* Lifestyle brands



  






 The exact title you've held matters less than the work you've actually done

 C V Raman Academy is an IIT\-JEE focused training institute dedicated to helping students and their parents identify the right opportunities and achieve their academic goals through high\-quality coaching. description:

title: Industrial Channel Sales
description:
**Channel Business Manager** 




**Location:** 
 Chennai, India
 



**Experience:** 
 5–10 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 







**Role Summary** 




 The Channel Business Manager will be responsible for developing and managing a network of distributors, system integrators, OEM partners and solution providers who can sell, implement and support our Industrial IoT solutions.
 



 The role requires a strong understanding of industrial automation products, channel business development, relationship management and consultative selling. The candidate should be comfortable working with both hardware and software solutions and be willing to travel extensively to develop and support partners.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Channel Development** 



* Identify, recruit and onboard distributors, value\-added resellers (VARs), system integrators and automation partners across India.
* Develop channel expansion plans for assigned regions and industry verticals.
* Identify and establish strategic channel partnerships in selected international markets.
* Evaluate prospective partners based on technical capability, market reach and business potential.



**Partner Management** 



* Build long\-term relationships with channel partners.
* Conduct regular business reviews and performance evaluations.
* Develop joint business plans and revenue targets with partners.
* Support partners in opportunity identification, customer engagement and solution positioning.
* Ensure partners remain engaged through regular communication and business support.



**Sales \& Business Development** 



* Achieve assigned channel sales targets.
* Generate new business through partner\-led opportunities.
* Work jointly with partners during customer presentations, demonstrations and solution discussions.
* Assist partners in preparing techno\-commercial proposals.
* Coordinate with internal technical and product teams to support customer requirements.



**Partner Enablement** 



* Conduct product training and certification programs for partners.
* Ensure partners are equipped to deploy and support our Pick\-to\-Light and Industrial IoT solutions.
* Develop sales enablement material and best practices for the channel ecosystem.
* Assist partners during pilot projects and initial deployments.



**Market Development** 



* Identify emerging market opportunities in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and smart factory automation.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Provide market feedback to product management for future product enhancements.
* Represent the company at exhibitions, seminars, industry events and partner conferences.



**International Business Support** 



* Identify potential distributors and system integration partners in overseas markets.
* Coordinate with international partners for product demonstrations, technical discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Support export\-oriented business development initiatives.
* Undertake overseas travel as required.



**Desired Candidate Profile** 




**Experience** 



* 5–10 years of experience in Channel Sales, Partner Management or Business Development.
* Prior experience in Industrial IoT, Factory Automation, Industrial Sensors, Machine Automation, PLC/SCADA, Industrial Networking or related industrial technology products.
* Experience working with distributors, automation system integrators or industrial solution providers.
* Exposure to software\-enabled industrial solutions will be an added advantage.



**Educational Qualification** 



* BSc, BE or B. Tech (Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Mechanical or related disciplines).



**Technical Knowledge** 




 Candidates should have exposure to one or more of the following:
 


* Industrial IoT Solutions
* Factory Automation
* Pick\-to\-Light Systems
* Industrial Sensors
* PLC/SCADA Systems
* MES / Manufacturing Software
* Industrial Communication Networks
* Barcode/RFID Solutions
* Smart Manufacturing Solutions
* Digital Factory Technologies



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Strong relationship\-building and networking abilities.
* Commercial negotiation and business development skills.
* Ability to understand customer applications and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Self\-driven, energetic and highly organized.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office.



**Travel Requirements** 



* Frequent travel across India to recruit, train and support channel partners.
* Periodic international travel for partner development, exhibitions and business meetings.
